# REST API reference

<!-- Generated by `cargo test -p sagat-tests --test contract_developer_experience`; SAGAT_DOCS_BLESS=1 rewrites it. Do not edit. -->

Made from `specs/001-platform-foundation/contracts/openapi.yaml` (version 0.4.0): 117 operations in 8 groups. The full contract (parameters, bodies, schemas, errors) is that file; this page is the map of it. Every call takes `Authorization: Bearer <token>` (the tenant is the token's) except these, which take no bearer token: `GET /health`, `GET /ready`, `POST /webhooks/{endpointId}`. The operations that take an `Idempotency-Key` are marked: a repeat with the same key and body answers the first result.
